name: TestLocalNetworkInstanceSuite/TestLocalNetInstanceACLsWithFlowLog
statusMessage:
timed out after 5m0.00066015s (excluding download) waiting for app "f55e7e99-3f15-49c6-a7c1-7fdb06f65102" (acl-app-1) on device "edge-dev" to reach RUNNING state (last state: RESOLVING_TAG)

Claude's conclusion:
zedbox is alive and not watchdog-restarted, consistent with a wedged goroutine rather than a crash.

### Root cause

The content tree `acl-app-1-image` (`be623fa5-f598-4e52-8a92-e927458e34e3`, `lfedge/evetest-ubuntu-ctr:1.0`) is stuck in `State:101` (RESOLVING_TAG) with empty `ContentSha256`, and `/run/downloader/ResolveStatus/` has no entry for it — the resolver goroutine never published a result (success or error). `zedbox` (pid 2926) is still alive and not watchdog-restarted, so this is a wedged tag-resolve HTTP call, not a crash — matching the app's `AppInstanceStatus` which is likewise parked at `State:101` waiting on the volume.

This is the identical, extensively documented signature in `live-ledger.md`: the same test (`TestLocalNetInstanceACLsWithFlowLog`/`acl-app-1`) hitting `RESOLVING_TAG` with no `ResolveStatus` has recurred repeatedly — first attributed to a missing timeout/deadline in the downloader's tag-resolve path (`resolveconfig.go`/`resolveimg.go`/`syncop.go` lacking a `context` import) on 2026-11-15 (run #19), and recurring again on 2026-11-17, twice on 2026-11-23 (run #42, against this exact test/app), and again on 2026-11-26/27. Tonight's occurrence is at least the 6th instance of this same known, unfixed bug, not a new regression.

No PR diff was given for this investigation, so no relatedness verdict applies.

Claude's conclusion:
**Root cause:** `acl-app-1`'s (and simultaneously `acl-app-2`'s) content-tree resolve of `lfedge/evetest-ubuntu-ctr:1.0` entered `manifestsDescImg`/`remote.Get` against the SDN registry at 04:20:54.321 and never logged completion, error, or retry in the ~5.5 minutes before timeout — no `ResolveStatus` was ever published for either app (`ls /run/downloader/ResolveStatus/` is empty), and `zedbox` (pid 2923) is alive and unwatchdogged, so this is a wedged goroutine, not a crash. I confirmed the registry itself is healthy: `curl` from the device to the same manifest endpoint with the correct Accept headers returns 200 instantly, so the hang is isolated to the resolver's own HTTP call, not the registry.

This is the same root cause already identified for `TestFlowLog`'s failure earlier in this same suite run (also RESOLVING_TAG, same image, same wedged `manifestsDescImg`/`remote.Get` pattern, no ResolveStatus emitted) — both trace back to `pkg/pillar/cmd/downloader/resolveimg.go`/`syncop.go` still lacking any `context` import, meaning the OCI tag-resolve path has no deadline on the underlying registry HTTP call. Per the ledger, this exact failure signature (stuck in RESOLVING_TAG under the 5-minute timeout, attributed to the same missing-timeout resolver code) is a known recurring issue going back to at least 2026-11-15 (run #19) and recurring again on 2026-11-17 (run #22); this is simply a second test within the same nightly run hitting the identical unfixed bug.
